metadata.description:
Acushnet River Valley Golf course is an upscale facility with great layout and condition. "One of the 10 best values in Massachusetts", says Golf Boston Travel and Leisure Magazine.
The Acushnet River Valley Golf Course is an excellent location for personal golf and tournament golf. Whether it is a small group or full shotgun, our staff is experienced and prepared to service all of your requirements from initial setup through the scoring of your event.
If you are looking for a nice day of golf with good service Acushnet River Valley is the place for you. We will promise you that our staff will make your experience the best possible. Please call at 508-998-7777 to reserve a tee time and enjoy our unique traditional/sottish links golf course.

metadata.description:
For nearly 20 years, New England Country Club in Bellingham, Massachusetts has welcomed golfers to play a round of golf. Open in 1991 New England Country Club has become known as the hometown destination for golf the whole family can enjoy. Each year new golfers are tested by our challenging 18 holes of golf. Leagues, tournaments and golf outings at New England CC are great ways to get together on the golf course. Be sure to take a look at what options are available to your group this year. Memberships are available for those interested in enjoying New England Country Club to the fullest.

There is always a new reason to enjoy a day of golf and fun times with family and friends at New England Country Club. Golf is the ideal way to enjoy the outdoors and the company of others.
